title: Contents Packout & Storage Dedicated Truck Charge for Oversized Items
content:
Contents Packout & Storage items too large for a vault move home on a dedicated truck. On the move-back truck line of a return: **when the largest oversized item quantity on the job's oversized item storage lines is at least the oversized move threshold, each oversized item carries the per-item oversized move charge; when it is one, the oversized item carries the single oversized move charge; a job with no oversized item storage line carries no oversized move charge.**

| Largest oversized item quantity on the job's oversized item storage lines | Oversized move charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (at least the oversized move threshold) | that number of items times 140.00 |
| 1 | 165.00 |
| no oversized item storage line | none |

**Cases.** Largest quantity 2: 280.00. Largest quantity 4: 560.00. Largest quantity 1: 165.00.
